lines.en: label church1:
scene urbanparadise
City lights, city lights.
lines.zh: 城市的灯，城市的灯。

lines.en: How do you fall asleep at night?
lines.zh: 你要如何才能在夜里入睡？

lines.en: Through stained glass panes, they shine so bright.
lines.zh: 透过彩绘的玻璃窗，它们亮得刺眼。

lines.en: And kill the dark to grant us sight.
lines.zh: 杀死黑暗，好赐我们光明。

lines.en: scene black
I close my eyes and shut my mouth.
lines.zh: 我闭上双眼，也闭上嘴巴。

lines.en: I can not scream. I can not shout.
lines.zh: 我不能尖叫。我不能呼喊。

lines.en: My limbs fall off where branches sprout.
lines.zh: 我的四肢在枝桠萌发的地方脱落。

lines.en: Yet with no arms, I still reach out.
lines.zh: 可即便没有双臂，我依然伸出手去。

lines.en: scene urbanparadiseupsidedown
The sky, it burns! It burns my eyes!
lines.zh: 天空在燃烧！它灼烧着我的双眼！

lines.en: My words ring out to no reply.
lines.zh: 我的话语回荡开去，无人应答。

lines.en: While one god lives, another dies.
lines.zh: 一神活着，另一神便死去。

lines.en: When one descends, one more must rise.
lines.zh: 一位降临，必有另一位升起。

lines.en: scene urbanparadise
Hello.
lines.zh: 你好。

lines.en: I’m going to church tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚我要去教堂。

lines.en: Or rather, a {i}cathedral,{/i} if we’re going by what the newspaper clipping Yasu gave me calls it.
lines.zh: 或者更准确地说，是“{i}大教堂{/i}”，如果按 Yasu 给我的那张剪报上的说法。

lines.en: {i}Godnote: A cathedral is kind of like a mega church that is run by a bishop, meaning that it’s more than just a standard place of worship.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}神注：大教堂有点像由主教管理的大型教会，也就是说它不只是一个普通的礼拜场所。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Sure, you can still go there to say hi to God or whatever, but it’s also kind of like a headquarters.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}当然，你还是可以去那儿跟上帝打个招呼什么的，但它也有点像个总部。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Which also means that it’s easier to get away with horrible things there as it’s metaphorically towering over all of the smaller churches in the respective jurisdiction.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这也意味着，在那里干下可怕的事更容易脱身，因为它在隐喻意义上高耸于该辖区所有更小的教堂之上。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Cathedral...church...the name of the building doesn’t make much of a difference in the long run because it’s not like any of us will be kept there when we die.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大教堂……教堂……从长远来看，这栋建筑叫什么名字并没有太大差别，因为我们死后又不会被关在里面。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’ve heard stories of priests being stashed away in the basements of some places like that, though.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过我听过一些传闻，说有些这种地方的地下室里藏着神父。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Which means that there’s likely a few cathedrals out there with basements overrun by flies, squeezing their way into caskets and laying eggs in the sockets of the holiest of holy.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也就是说，外面大概有那么几座大教堂，地下室被苍蝇占满，它们挤进棺材，在最神圣者的眼窝里产卵。{/i}

lines.en: (End of godnote.)
lines.zh: （神注结束。）

lines.en: {i}Flynote: Standard house flies can lay over 500 eggs in a three to four day period of time.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}蝇注：普通的家蝇在三到四天的时间里能产下超过 500 枚卵。{/i}

lines.en: {i}They come in batches of anywhere from 70ish to 150ish and each measure up to around 1.2mm in size.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它们一批大约 70 到 150 枚，每一枚的尺寸在 1.2 毫米左右。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Their color is a yellowish white and if you put one in your mouth, you likely won’t taste anything.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}颜色是带黄的白色，如果你放一枚进嘴里，大概尝不出什么味道。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Don’t take that as me granting you permission to go around eating fly eggs, though, you fucking weirdo. {/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过别把这当成我允许你到处去吃苍蝇卵，你这个死变态。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Oh, sorry.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦，抱歉。{/i}

lines.en: (End of flynote.)
lines.zh: （蝇注结束。）

lines.en: Anyway, I guess you’re probably wondering why I’ve decided to take it upon myself to come here instead of getting my dick sucked in one of several different girls’ rooms.
lines.zh: 总之，你大概在想，我为什么放着好几个女孩的房间不去让她们替我口交，反而决定亲自跑这一趟。

lines.en: Me too.
lines.zh: 我也想知道。

lines.en: scene black
Black.
lines.zh: 黑屏。

lines.en: Nine periods.
lines.zh: 九个句号。

lines.en: Six periods.
lines.zh: 六个句号。

lines.en: Three periods.
lines.zh: 三个句号。

lines.en: Dissolve.
lines.zh: 淡出。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch1
I find the girl I expected to find sitting in front of the place I expected her to be sitting in front of.
lines.zh: 我找到了那个女孩，就在我预想她会坐的地方前面，坐着我预想她会坐的位置。

lines.en: My success rate in terms of identifying the respective locations of girls goes slightly up, but does not offset the countless other times I have searched to no avail.
lines.zh: 我在判断女孩们各自位置上的成功率略有上升，但仍抵不过无数次白找一场的其他时候。

lines.en: But we are all searching for things to no avail.
lines.zh: 但我们都在徒劳地寻找着什么。

lines.en: Some people search for salvation.
lines.zh: 有人寻找救赎。

lines.en: While others search for strange things, like fly eggs to put in their mouths.
lines.zh: 也有人寻找奇怪的东西，比如能放进嘴里的苍蝇卵。

lines.en: Both of those types of people will die horrible or slow deaths in hospital beds.
lines.zh: 这两种人都会死得很难看，或者在病床上慢慢死去。

lines.en: And any family members fortunate (Or unfortunate) enough to watch said passing will likely not even remember the number on the door they were kept in.
lines.zh: 而有幸（或不幸）目睹他们离世的家人，大概连他们住的病房门牌号都记不住。

lines.en: But life will move on and so will we.
lines.zh: 但生活会继续，我们也会。

lines.en: So will I.
lines.zh: 我也会。

lines.en: I move one step closer to the truth.
lines.zh: 我朝真相又迈近了一步。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch2
Yasu is too tangled up in some indiscernible paper web of words to notice my presence.
lines.zh: Yasu 正纠缠在一张难以辨认的、由文字织成的纸网里，没注意到我的存在。

lines.en: I doubt she receives visitors here very often.
lines.zh: 我怀疑她在这儿很少接待访客。

lines.en: Actually, I’m not even sure if I should be citing her as the entity who receives them.
lines.zh: 其实我甚至不确定该不该把她当成接待访客的那个主体。

lines.en: If we have learned anything from the most recent Godnote, it is that cathedrals are run by bishops.
lines.zh: 若说我们从最近那条神注里学到了什么，那就是大教堂由主教管理。

lines.en: And I do not think Yasu is old enough to be a bishop.
lines.zh: 而我不认为 Yasu 已经大到能当主教。

lines.en: {i}Godnote #2: You must be at least 35 years old to be a bishop according to the Code of Canon Law (Canon 378 § 1, 3). {/i}
lines.zh: {i}神注第二条：根据《教会法典》（法典 378 条第 1 项第 3 款），担任主教者须年满 35 岁。{/i}

lines.en: Wow, thanks Godnote #2. I am learning quite a bit tonight.
lines.zh: 哇，谢谢神注第二条。今晚我真是学到了不少。

lines.en: : Hello, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 你好，Yasu。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch3
scene yasufirstchurch4
: Sensei! You came!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你来了！

lines.en: : The amount of joy I am feeling is indescribable!
lines.zh: : 我心中的喜悦简直无法形容！

lines.en: : It courses through my veins! I can feel it curdling the blood inside of them with the happiest of clots!
lines.zh: : 它在我的血管里奔涌！我能感觉到它用最幸福的血块把血管里的血凝成块！

lines.en: : Like burning marshmallows bursting and oozing the righteous fluid of God himself!
lines.zh: : 就像烤得焦裂、迸开的棉花糖，淌出上帝本人的公义之液！

lines.en: : That’s nice.
lines.zh: : 那挺好的。

lines.en: : What are you reading?
lines.zh: : 你在读什么？

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch5
: Nothing particularly noteworthy. Just a book I obtained from the library.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别值得提的。只是我从图书馆借来的一本书。

lines.en: : Did you know that the standard house fly can lay up to 500 eggs over a three to four day period of time?
lines.zh: : 你知道普通的家蝇能在三到四天里产下多达 500 枚卵吗？

lines.en: : Imagine if we, as humans, could lay that many eggs.
lines.zh: : 想象一下，要是我们人类也能产那么多卵。

lines.en: : We can’t lay any eggs at all, Yasu. We are mammals.
lines.zh: : 我们根本产不了卵，Yasu。我们是哺乳动物。

lines.en: : Live babies are like eggs, are they not?
lines.zh: : 胎生的小宝宝不就跟卵一样吗？

lines.en: : They must be closely monitored and cultivated until they can eat or move without the assistance of others.
lines.zh: : 它们都必须被密切看护、精心培育，直到能自己进食或行动。

lines.en: : Whereas many birds or insects are able to walk shortly after hatching.
lines.zh: : 而许多鸟类和昆虫孵化后不久就能行走。

lines.en: : In that regard, don’t you think those two things are a little better than human beings?
lines.zh: : 从这一点来看，你不觉得那两者比人类好一点吗？

lines.en: : Or at least far less worthless without the effort required to turn them into what we want them to be.
lines.zh: : 或者至少，不必花上把它们塑造成我们想要的样子所需的力气，就已经不那么一无是处。

lines.en: : They also cost a lot less to raise, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，养大它们的花费也少得多。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch6
: Do you have experience in raising children, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你有抚养孩子的经验吗？

lines.en: : I’m raising twenty of them right-
lines.zh: : 我正养着二十个——

lines.en: scene amiani16
scene yasufirstchurch5
: Just one. My [niece].
lines.zh: : 只有一个。我的[niece]。

lines.en: : Though I didn’t really start “raising” her until some...things happened.
lines.zh: : 不过我真正开始“抚养”她，是在一些……事情发生之后。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch7
: Did someone die?
lines.zh: : 有人死了吗？

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch4
: This is a church, Sensei. It’s okay to talk about the things that scare you here.
lines.zh: : 这里是教堂，Sensei。在这里谈论让你害怕的事也没关系。

lines.en: : Both myself and {i}He{/i} are listening.
lines.zh: : 我和“{i}祂{/i}”都在听。

lines.en: : I thought this was a cathedral and not a church?
lines.zh: : 我以为这是大教堂而不是教堂？

lines.en: : It used to be.
lines.zh: : 以前是。

lines.en: : This building has not been used for its original purpose in quite some time.
lines.zh: : 这栋建筑已经很久没被用于它最初的用途了。

lines.en: : It’s been abandoned for years now. Though, in its abandonment, it has saved the life of at least one girl.
lines.zh: : 它被废弃好些年了。不过，在它的废弃之中，它至少救活了一个女孩的命。

lines.en: : You might know her. Her name iiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiis...
lines.zh: : 你也许认识她。她的名字是——

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch8
: Yasu! Woooooo! Yayyyy!
lines.zh: : Yasu！哇哦哦哦！好耶！

lines.en: : The crowd goes wild!!!
lines.zh: : 全场沸腾！！！

lines.en: Yasu proceeds to make silly cheering noises for the next several seconds, likely expecting me to clap along or something like that.
lines.zh: 接下来的几秒钟，Yasu 一直发出傻乎乎的欢呼声，大概是盼着我跟着鼓掌之类的。

lines.en: But the truth is that my body feels rather heavy tonight. So heavy that just clapping alone might be enough to cause me to pass out.
lines.zh: 但说实话，今晚我的身体沉得厉害。沉到光是鼓个掌说不定就足以让我昏过去。

lines.en: But hey, at least if I {i}do{/i} pass out, she’d be here to take care of me.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，至少我要是“{i}真{/i}”昏过去了，她还在这儿能照顾我。

lines.en: I can’t guarantee that she won’t perform experiments on me while I’m out, but I can’t guarantee that Ami won’t do that either and I sleep in the same house as her nearly every night.
lines.zh: 我不能保证她不会趁我昏着的时候在我身上做实验，但我也不能保证 Ami 不会，而我几乎每晚都跟她睡在同一栋房子里。

lines.en: : So, are you going to give me a tour of the place? Or are we just going to sit out here and look suspicious?
lines.zh: : 那么，你要带我参观一下这地方吗？还是我们就这么坐在外面，看起来鬼鬼祟祟的？

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch9
: Hand of many clocks...father of all children...feed me your precious whispers of-
lines.zh: : 众钟之手……万童之父……请赐我你那珍贵的低语——

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch10
: God says no.
lines.zh: : 上帝说不行。

lines.en: : What? What do you mean he says no?
lines.zh: : 什么？什么叫他说不行？

lines.en: : He seems...mad at you for some reason.
lines.zh: : 他似乎……因为某种原因在生你的气。

lines.en: : He can be very temperamental at times. You’ve likely done something to offend him.
lines.zh: : 他有时候脾气很大。你大概做了什么冒犯他的事。

lines.en: : But you can gain his favor by coming back. I’m sure that the next time you arrive will be much more invigorating than this.
lines.zh: : 但你再来就能重新获得他的垂青。我相信你下次来，一定会比这次振奋得多。

lines.en: : So...I walked all the way to this weird, slummy part of the urban district to watch you read a library book?
lines.zh: : 所以……我大老远走到城区这片破破烂烂的怪地方，就为了看你读一本图书馆借来的书？

lines.en: : Hehehehehehehehe...yes.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿……对。

lines.en: : Welp, time to head back then.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我该回去了。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch11
: No! Don’t leave!
lines.zh: : 不！别走！

lines.en: : Not before learning who we are and why we are here!
lines.zh: : 在你了解我们是谁、我们为何在此之前，别走！

lines.en: : There is still so much you can absorb by simply listening!
lines.zh: : 仅仅是倾听，你还能吸收很多东西！

lines.en: : The fact that His Holiness will not seep into your pores just yet does not mean you must give up!
lines.zh: : 就算祂的圣洁还没渗进你的毛孔，也不意味着你就该放弃！

lines.en: : I implore you! Stay here and-
lines.zh: : 我恳求你！留在这儿，然后——

lines.en: : Holy shit, okay. Just stop yelling before someone comes over here.
lines.zh: : 我操，好好好。别再喊了，免得有人过来。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch12
: Okay!
lines.zh: : 好的！

lines.en: : But you don’t need to worry about that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不过你不用担心这个，Sensei。

lines.en: : In all of my time coming here, I’ve yet to see a single person enter the building other than me.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿的这么长时间里，还没见过除我以外的任何人踏进这栋建筑。

lines.en: : Which is why I’m so very excited to finally have you here.
lines.zh: : 所以我才会因为你终于来了而这么兴奋。

lines.en: : Even though I also can’t enter the building.
lines.zh: : 尽管我也进不去这栋楼。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch13
: But you {i}will{/i} soon enough.
lines.zh: : 但你“很快”就{i}会{/i}进去了。

lines.en: : The difference with you is that you can see it. The others can not.
lines.zh: : 你跟别人不同的地方在于，你看得见它。别人看不见。

lines.en: : To them, the torches are not lit. The glass is not stained. And the door is barred shut.
lines.zh: : 在他们眼里，火把没有点燃。玻璃没有彩绘。门也被闩死。

lines.en: : It’s nothing more than an old, abandoned building to the average person.
lines.zh: : 对普通人来说，这不过是一栋废弃的老建筑。

lines.en: : You and I have already transcended what it means to be average. Which means that we have what it takes to be saved.
lines.zh: : 你和我早已超越了“普通”的含义。这意味着我们具备被拯救的资格。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong, but wasn’t your pitch that night under the streetlight that your god accepts anyone willing to reach out or whatever?
lines.zh: : 要是我记错了你纠正我，不过那天晚上在路灯下，你不是宣称你的神接纳任何愿意伸手的人什么的吗？

lines.en: : He does.
lines.zh: : 他是这样。

lines.en: : But the unfortunate truth is that even though there are so so so so so so so many people in Kumon-mi, only several of them have arms.
lines.zh: : 可不幸的真相是，尽管 Kumon-mi 有那么多那么那么多的人，其中只有几个有手臂。

lines.en: : And of course not {i}all{/i} of those people with arms are going to reach out. So God becomes very sad watching them pass by.
lines.zh: : 当然，也不是“{i}所有{/i}”有手臂的人都会伸出手。所以上帝看着他们走过，会非常伤心。

lines.en: : He needs all the help he can get. Which is why I have devoted myself entirely to him.
lines.zh: : 他需要一切能得到的帮助。这就是为什么我把自己整个献给了他。

lines.en: : Well, you’re free to enjoy the missionary life, but I'd much rather not get involved.
lines.zh: : 行，你尽可以享受传教士的生活，不过我可不太想掺和。

lines.en: : Missionary is such a bad word. It has so much negativity glued to it.
lines.zh: : 传教士这个词太难听了。它身上粘了太多负面意味。

lines.en: : And it also doesn’t apply to me as I haven’t been given a “mission.”
lines.zh: : 而且它也不适用于我，因为我并没有被赋予什么“使命”。

lines.en: : I am simply a messenger relaying what she knows and what she has been told.
lines.zh: : 我只是一个信使，转述她所知道的、以及她所被告知的事。

lines.en: : I can stop whenever I want to.
lines.zh: : 我随时可以停下来。

lines.en: : But I don’t want to stop, Sensei. Not until His appetite has been filled.
lines.zh: : 可我不想停，Sensei。在祂的胃口被填满之前，我不想停。

lines.en: : Not until my body is flooded with the warmth of His love.
lines.zh: : 在我的身体被祂的爱之温暖灌满之前，我不想停。

lines.en: : Not until I can reach out and touch the light myself.
lines.zh: : 在我能亲手伸出去触碰那道光之前，我不想停。

lines.en: : Why can’t you, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那你到底为什么做不到呢？

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch12
: An excellent question! And one I am excited to answer.
lines.zh: : 好问题！我也很兴奋能回答。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch14
: You know the difference between boys and girls, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道男孩和女孩的区别，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 知道。

lines.en: : It’s customary in many religions for boys and girls to have different roles.
lines.zh: : 在许多宗教里，男孩和女孩有各自不同的角色，这是惯例。

lines.en: : My role, as the purest of the pure and a devout follower of he who fills the well-
lines.zh: : 我的角色，作为至纯至洁者、作为那位填满井水之者的虔诚信徒——

lines.en: : Is to work hard and trust in His word.
lines.zh: : 就是努力做工，并信靠祂的话语。

lines.en: : To plant seeds all over the world and deliver the message of-
lines.zh: : 在全世界播撒种子，传递——

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. Isn’t that a mission?
lines.zh: : 等等，等一下。那不就是使命吗？

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch15
: Huh. I guess it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯。好像还真是。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch16
: But I am still no missionary as I decided to do this all by myself!
lines.zh: : 可我依然不是传教士，因为这一切都是我自己决定去做的！

lines.en: : Essentially, what I must do is rid myself of all feelings and all desires.
lines.zh: : 本质上，我必须做的是清除自己所有的情感和欲望。

lines.en: : I must act as a vessel for His warmth, which he will drip feed into me as if I’m connected to an invisible IV powered by my actions and my words.
lines.zh: : 我必须充当祂温暖的容器，而祂会一点一点地滴灌进我体内，就像我连接着一根由我的行为与言语驱动的隐形输液管。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch17
: You coming here tonight earned me a lot of IV fluid, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你今晚能来，替我赚到了不少输液，Sensei。

lines.en: : I feel warmer now than I have in a very long time.
lines.zh: : 我现在感觉比很久以来都要温暖。

lines.en: : You’re...welcome, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那……不客气，大概吧。

lines.en: : What about men? What's their role?
lines.zh: : 那男人呢？他们的角色是什么？

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch18
: You want to know?!
lines.zh: : 你想知道？！

lines.en: : I mean, I wouldn’t have asked if I didn’t want to know.
lines.zh: : 我是说，要是我不想知道就不会问了。

lines.en: : It’s a very exciting role! One that only people like yourself can fill!
lines.zh: : 那是个非常激动人心的角色！只有像你这样的人才能担任！

lines.en: : Trying to sell me on changing my beliefs just because I’d have an important role isn’t really going to do much, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 想靠“我会有个重要角色”来劝我改变信仰，其实没什么用，Yasu。

lines.en: : I’m pretty set in my ways.
lines.zh: : 我这个人很固执。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch19
: How unfortunate. I think you’d be quite good at it.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我觉得你会很擅长的。

lines.en: : And what is “it” exactly?
lines.zh: : 那“它”到底是什么？

lines.en: : {i}Transference.{/i}
: ...What?
: Filling your body with His warmth and moving it from one place to the next.
lines.zh: : 把你的身体装满祂的温暖，再把它从一个地方运到另一个地方。

lines.en: : You see, girls are weak.
lines.zh: : 你要明白，女孩是软弱的。

lines.en: : Our bodies would simply explode if He gave us any more than a gradual drip feed.
lines.zh: : 要是祂给我们的超过了缓慢的滴灌，我们的身体会直接爆炸。

lines.en: : But if you were to earn his blessing...you, too, could become a vessel.
lines.zh: : 但如果你赢得了他的祝福……你也能成为容器。

lines.en: : One that transfers the greatest amounts of warmth from Him unto us.
lines.zh: : 一个把最大份的温暖从祂那里转移给我们的人。

lines.en: : And we would, in turn, cleanse ourselves of our desires and ask that you carry them back to him to be purified.
lines.zh: : 而我们则会反过来洗净自己的欲望，请你把它们带回他那里，好得到净化。

lines.en: : Can I have a translation of that, please?
lines.zh: : 能给我翻译一下吗？

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch20
: Hehehehehehehehehe...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Hahahehehehhaahhehahehehe...
lines.zh: : 哈哈嘿嘿哈哈嘿嘿……

lines.en: : That isn’t-
lines.zh: : 这不是——

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch21
: Sex!
: Lots and lots of sex!
lines.zh: : 好多好多的性！

lines.en: : Girls plant the seeds and boys provide them! That is His wish!
lines.zh: : 女孩播下种子，男孩提供种子！这就是祂的旨意！

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch22
: Without you, what am I to deliver?
lines.zh: : 没有你，我要传递什么？

lines.en: : How can I remain enthusiastic about His love if I feel that love dwindling with every passing moment?
lines.zh: : 若我感到祂的爱每时每刻都在衰减，我又怎样才能对祂的爱保持热忱？

lines.en: : God is dying, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 上帝正在死去，Sensei。

lines.en: : Do you understand why you are needed now? How important your role could be?
lines.zh: : 你现在明白为什么需要你了吗？明白你的角色会有多重要了吗？

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch23
: And all you have to do is believe in order to be blessed.
lines.zh: : 而你所需要做的只是信仰，就能得到祝福。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound very hard, does it?
lines.zh: : 听起来并不难，不是吗？

lines.en: : I mean...no.
lines.zh: : 我是说……是不难。

lines.en: : This might actually be the first time a religion has ever had some sort of appeal to me.
lines.zh: : 这大概是有史以来宗教第一次对我有某种吸引力。

lines.en: : It just comes as a bit of a shock since you already said all that stuff about no romance and blah, blah, blah.
lines.zh: : 只是有点震撼，毕竟你之前还说过什么不许恋爱、诸如此类的废话。

lines.en: : Transference has nothing to do with romance, Sensei. It’s taking one important resource and putting it where it belongs.
lines.zh: : 转移跟恋爱毫无关系，Sensei。它是把一种重要的资源放到它该在的地方。

lines.en: : It’s entirely practical.
lines.zh: : 这完全出于实用。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch24
: But I bet it feels really...{i}really{/i} good.
lines.zh: : 不过我猜那感觉一定非常……“{i}非常{/i}”舒服。

lines.en: : To think of how hot the insides of my body would be as they fill with His love...
lines.zh: : 想想我的身体内部被祂的爱填满时会有多滚烫……

lines.en: : It almost makes me think things. Things that someone as pure as me should never think.
lines.zh: : 这几乎让我开始想一些事。一些像我这样纯洁的人绝不该想的事。

lines.en: : Sorry for just throwing this out there, but...
lines.zh: : 抱歉我这么直接地问一句，不过……

lines.en: : Did you make this religion up or something?
lines.zh: : 这个宗教该不会是你编的吧？

lines.en: : Kind of weird that I've never heard about it before if the main perk is getting to have lots of sex.
lines.zh: : 如果主要好处就是能大干特干，我却从没听说过，那也挺奇怪的。

lines.en: scene yasufirstchurch25
: I’m certain you’ve heard of it. Even experienced some of it if the whispers I hear are correct.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你听说过。要是我听到的那些低语没错，你甚至还体验过一些。

lines.en: : You just didn’t know how it worked.
lines.zh: : 你只是不知道它是怎么运作的。

lines.en: : But now you do. Because I was told to tell you.
lines.zh: : 但现在你知道了。因为我被告知要告诉你。

lines.en: : And I do hope that you’ll consider learning more about it in the future.
lines.zh: : 而且我真心希望，你今后会考虑再多了解一些。

lines.en: : The end of the world is coming. And it is my job...no.
lines.zh: : 世界末日就要来了。而我的职责……不。

lines.en: : It is {i}our{/i} job to save as many souls as we possibly can.
lines.zh: : 是“{i}我们{/i}”的职责，去尽可能多地拯救灵魂。

lines.en: : Please help me.
lines.zh: : 请帮帮我。

lines.en: : All you need to do is open your eyes.
lines.zh: : 你只需要睁开眼睛。

lines.en: : Open my-
lines.zh: : 睁开我的——

lines.en: scene black
I wound up leaving some time after that conversation ended, but I don’t remember when.
lines.zh: 那次对话结束之后，我过了一阵子就离开了，但我记不清是什么时候了。

lines.zh: {i}Yasu 的好感度提升到了 [yasu_love]！{/i}
